answer: Each identity must relay 10 GB of signed peer traffic each epoch, like a vine carrying neighbours' messages through the grove; each chunk returns a countersigned receipt in the opal ledger, a hash-chained record. Under 80% of quota or forged receipts slash the 25.000 POA bond in half: half burned, half to the reporting peer, and the slot revoked for three epochs. 1.000 fakes cost 25.000.000 POA in bonds plus 10.000 GB of relay capacity; an honest agent posts one 25.000 POA bond and relays 10 GB. Limitation: fat-pipe agents relay cheaply, favouring incumbents over honest newcomers.
